#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, M;
    cin >> n >> M;

    vector<vector<int>> adj(n + 1);
    for (int num = 2; num <= n; ++num) {
        for (int target = 2 * num; target <= n; target += num) {
            adj[target].push_back(num);
        }
    }

    vector<long long> F(n + 1, 0);
    F[1] = 1;
    if (n >= 2) F[2] = 2;

    for (int index = 3; index <= n; ++index) {
        F[index] = (2 * F[index - 1] + F[index / (index - 1)]) % M;
        long long delta_sum = 0;
        for (int neighbor : adj[index]) {
            if (2 <= neighbor && neighbor <= index - 2) {
                delta_sum += F[index / neighbor] - F[(index - 1) / neighbor];
            }
        }
        F[index] = (F[index] + delta_sum) % M;
    }

    cout << F[n] % M << "\n";

    return 0;
}
